Guessing at most n equivalence-relation adjacency matrices, proposition and constant valuations uses O(nN²+nN log U)=2^{O(n log n)} bits. Bottom-up semantic evaluation including conditionally agreeing value pairs is polynomial in this representation. The derived SAT and complementary VAL complexity inclusions therefore hold on the asserted announcement-free explicit-syntax domain.
